# 2027 Kyrgyz presidential election

Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Kyrgyzstan on 24 January 2027.
Background
Since Japorov assumed the presidency in 2021 the country has been described as having gone into democratic backsliding.
Electoral system
The elections were held using the two-round system, where if no candidate received a majority in the first round, a second would be held between the top two finishers. Under the 2021 constitution, the presidential term was changed from one term of six years to two terms of five years.
